holes_found.description: CROSS-FILE NUMERIC INCONSISTENCY + WRONG DISPLAYED ARITHMETIC on the Schumann floor. SEC-2.16 states the quarter-wave floor as ~8.77 Hz (body + TLDR), but the WIN panels for the same quantity say 8.78 Hz: wins.json uses 8.78 (14 occurrences; WIN-038.finding explicitly reads cavity minimum is 8.78 Hz at the pole), while sections.json uses 8.77 (14 occurrences). The two data files disagree on the SAME number SEC-2.16 cross-references (it links WIN-038/048/029 and is verdict-tagged to WIN-034). The value 8.77 is also the WRONG rounding: f=c/(4*8537 km)=8.78 Hz (precise c), and SEC 2.1 prints the explicit division 300,000/(4 x 8,537) approx 8.77 Hz, but that division equals 8.785 (8.79 with c=300,000, 8.78 with precise c). Neither convention yields 8.77. A defender can cite our own flagship Schumann refutation: floor printed as 8.77 in prose but 8.78 in WIN cards, with a displayed division that does not compute -- the same internal-consistency standard we hold the dome to.
holes_found.recommendation: Reconcile site-wide to the arithmetically-correct 8.78 Hz and fix the displayed division in SEC 2.1. SITE-WIDE, not local to SEC-2.16: also implicates queue item 486 (ISS-2580), which just standardized part6 to 8.77 -- the WRONG direction. If a conservative floor is desired, write >= 8.78 Hz (conservatively >= 8.77) rather than a single value whose stated division is wrong. Recommend ONE decider pass setting 8.78 across sections.json + wins.json and correcting the explicit calc.

kernel_of_truth.description: The section credits its own kernel correctly and refuses the easy exegesis bust: the Hebrew is genuine -- Job 37:18 uses mutsaq (the casting verb) with a cast-metal-mirror simile, Deut 28:23 uses nehoshet (bronze/copper) (data/sections.json part2 SEC-2.16 kernel-of-truth paragraph). The dome did not invent the etymology and the section explicitly grants the literal reading rather than relying on rejecting it.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Granting the literal Hebrew is what powers the refutation: once cast-copper is a load-bearing spec, copper EM properties apply and the dome own commitments collide -- radio astronomy through a copper-opaque shell, WIN-048 CMB at 160 GHz (skin depth ~0.16 um, verified), and WIN-038 7.83 Hz vs the H(r)=8,537*exp(-r/8,619) quarter-wave floor of 8.78 Hz (data/wins.json WIN-038.finding; data/sections.json SEC-2.1). Being right about the etymology is precisely what indicts the physics.

deeper_analysis: Queue item 481 was a class:verification re-review of the 5 patches the decider self-applied after c1. Verify-mode handoff (PROP-038) did not apply: gate (b) fails because c1 had holes_found.length=5 (>2), so this stayed in curmudgeon scope. All five c1 holes are closed (see patch_verification) and introduced no new defects in the patched passages -- skin-depth values, infimum/minimum terminology, WIN-029 chain attribution, discontinuous-shell defender counter, and TLDR frequency attribution are all now correct. The one new finding is a pre-existing cross-file numeric inconsistency (8.77 vs 8.78) c1 did not isolate (c1 hole 1 addressed only the supremum/infimum terminology, not the value/rounding). It surfaced here because verifying the TLDR fix (ISS-2577) required reading 8.77 against the WIN panels it summarizes. The argument is unaffected -- both values sit ~12 percent above 7.83 Hz -- so severity is moderate (credibility/consistency, not argument-breaking). Counter-argument considered: 8.77 could be a deliberately conservative floor; even so, a displayed division that does not equal its printed result, plus disagreement with the WIN cards, are exploitable defects. Fix is a one-pass site-wide reconciliation to 8.78 plus correcting the displayed calculation.
